incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008, artículos 4-5 (formation by private document), 17 (legal representation), 23 (bylaws), 45 (free allocation of capital); supplemented by Código de Comercio, arts. 354 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Law 1258/2008 imposes no minimum paid-up capital; all worldwide subscribed capital must be paid within a term not exceeding three years. Cash contributions require no escrow account; paid capital is freely available to the corporation upon registration. In-kind contributions must be identified in the bylaws with transfer inventory and the contributor's NIT.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the shareholders hereby confirm the immediate subscription and payment of the fully subscribed share capital as set out in the bylaws and declare the constitution of the corporation as a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) under Law 1258 of 2008. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at Calle 100 No. 8A – 55, Oficina 601, Bogotá D.C., Colombia, for all corporate purposes. FURTHER RESOLVED, that María Elena Restrepo is appointed as sole legal representative and general manager, and Camila Torres is appointed as alternate legal representative, each empowered to execute commercial, fiscal, banking, and customs acts within the corporate purpose. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name availability and homonymy certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – RUES Virtual (Ventanilla Única Empresarial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names through the RUES web portal. Pay the consultation fee and obtain the Certificado de Homonimia approving an exclusive S.A.S. name. The certificate is valid for 30 business days; file before expiry.
required_dossiers: passport or cédula de extranjería of each subscribing shareholder
power of attorney if filed by a third-party agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity, file an immediate reconsideration or present a modified name list; the Registry must issue a final ruling within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of the S.A.S. private incorporation document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public, Bogotá circuit; alternatively direct private document under Law 1258/2008
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws in Spanish: corporate name, domicile, duration, scope covering wholesale botanical trading under ISIC 4631 and NAICS 424490, subscribed and paid capital, privacy clauses, administration and representation, financial year-end, and dissolution. If no real estate contribution is involved, no public deed is mandatory; legalize signatures before a notary to facilitate registry acceptance.
required_dossiers: valid passports or national IDs of shareholders
capital payment evidence if paid before registry filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary or registry identifies a formal defect, correct the private document by an amendment, re-sign before the same notary, and replace the affected folio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration with Chamber of Commerce and RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registration Office / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed private instrument to the Chamber's registration window, complete the Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil, pay the registration fee and registration tax (0.7% of subscribed capital), and collect the Certificado de Cámara de Comercio confirming legal existence.
required_dossiers: ID of legal representative and acceptance of office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry files a 'requerimiento', answer within 30 days by filing corrected documents; unresolved issues may lead to administrative enforcement and require a fresh filing with a justified continuity statement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: NIT and RUT registration with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Subdirección de Impuestos y Aduanas; portal at effective-dian.serviciosenlinea.gov.co
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After commercial registration, complete the Registro Único Tributario form, obtain the NIT, apply for the electronic invoicing certification, and verify the IVA, Retención en la Fuente, and ICA tax classifications. Register the entity in the VUCE export registry if the first export operation will be filed by the SAS directly.
required_dossiers: proof of registered office address in Bogotá
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN assigns a partial validity status or requests additional information, file a corrective RUT and reply to the formal requirement within ten working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sectorial health registration for food and herbal export (INVIMA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INVIMA – Dirección de Alimentos y Bebidas / Ventanilla Integral de Trámites (VIT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Registro Sanitario de Alimentos application describing dried Lycium barbarum and herbal botanicals intended for wholesale export. If operating strictly as an agricultural raw exporter, request the Certificado Sanitario de Exportación and include species identification, phytosanitary documentation, and certificate of analysis for the destination market.
required_dossiers: NIT and RUT of the SAS
product formulation and botanical species identification
product labels in Spanish and English
quality control and certificate of analysis
warehouse technical sheet and packing procedures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If INVIMA objects, submit an additional COA, pharmacopoeia monograph, or reclassify the product from a food supplement to herbal tea / botanical ingredient and resubmit the modified dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal industrial registration and operational authorizations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Mayor de Bogotá – Impuesto de Industria y Comercio; Cuerpo de Bomberos Oficial; Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SAS in the Registro de Industria y Comercio to legalize commercial/warehouse activity. Obtain the fire-safety inspection certification, register employees with an ARL for occupational risk coverage, and submit any required environmental self-management report to the Corporación Autónoma Regional.
required_dossiers: lease deed or ownership title of the warehouse
employee payroll registry and ARL affiliation proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal authority rejects the ICA registration, file a reconsideration with corrected commercial activity codes and provide the required structural/fire certificates within 15 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA (Dirección de Alimentos y Bebidas) and Secretaría Distrital de Desarrollo Económico; Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá for Registro de Industria y Comercio
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Alimentos / Certificado Sanitario de Exportación de Alimentos

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Cundinamarca (CAR) in coordination with Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Environmental registration (Registro de Instrumentos de Control y Vigilancia Ambiental) for low-impact packing and warehousing; a full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (EIA) applies only to industrial drying/processing operations with significant extraction or high-emission combustion
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must comply with Resolution 0631 of 2015 for the food/botanical sector (pH 6.0-9.0; TSS not exceeding 80 mg/L; COD/BOD5 per treatment design); air emissions must comply with Resolution 909 of 2008 and Decree 1076 of 2015, including VOC controls if annual solvent use exceeds established municipality thresholds; solid botanical waste must be channeled through authorized recycling or disposal under Law 1259 of 2008

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Inspección Técnica de Seguridad y Evacuación issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos; structural load certification for storage rack systems from the local planning authority; and workplace health and safety clearance registered with the Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL)

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), Colombia's unified tax and customs authority, administered through the Registro Único Tributario (RUT), the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), the Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) platform, and the SIGLO XXI/VUCE customs systems. Official portal: www.dian.gov.co. Foreign-exchange controls and export proceed repatriation requirements are supervised by Banco de la República.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S. owned by non-resident shareholders: (1) incorporate the S.A.S. before the Cámara de Comercio with a locally appointed legal representative; (2) within one month of commercial registration, complete the RUT registration on the DIAN portal, stating ISIC 4631 and declaring status as an exporter, obtaining a provisional NIT that becomes definitive upon DIAN validation; (3) obtain the company's NIT and a digital signature certificate (certificado digital) for electronic tax filings and e-invoicing; (4) register the entity in the RUT as a VAT responsible (Responsable del IVA) and an income-tax declarant; (5) for a non-resident juridical owner without a local establishment, a simplified NIT may be issued pursuant to Decreto 2788/2013 and applicable DIAN resolutions, subject to appointment of a local representative, a notarised and apostilled power of attorney, and disclosure of the beneficial owner; (6) request customs authorisation and exporter activation in the RUT before lodging any export declaration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the S.A.S. is taxed at entity level on its worldwide income under the ordinary corporate income tax regime; shareholders are not attributed the company's income; dividends and profit distributions to non-resident shareholders are subject to Colombian-source dividend/withholding taxation. Territorial_Scope applies only to non-resident entities and foreign-company branches, which are taxed exclusively on Colombian-source income rather than worldwide income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. Statutory elections available to an S.A.S. include: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under Law 2010/2019, electable by qualifying taxpayers whose prior-year gross revenue does not exceed 80,000 UVT; (ii) the Compañía Holding Colombiana (CHC) election, notified to DIAN, which allows qualified foreign-source dividends and capital gains to be exempt from Colombian withholding taxation; (iii) neutral tax treatment upon election for qualified business reorganisations (mergers, split-offs) under Articles 31–35 of the Tax Statute, deferring income recognition if the economic-substance condition is met; hybrid-mismatch consequences are imposed by law under the Law 2277/2022 anti-hybrid rules, not by taxpayer election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas), with exports of goods and certain offshore services zero-rated rather than exempt.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Legal entities such as the S.A.S. are automatically VAT-responsible with no minimum turnover threshold. Natural persons become VAT-responsible when prior-year gross income from taxable activities exceeds 100,000 UVT (approximately COP 4.98 billion based on the 2025 UVT of COP 49,799); below that threshold natural persons may voluntarily register to obtain export-refund eligibility. Exporters of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals remain VAT-responsible and must file periodic IVA returns even though their exports are invoiced at 0%.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Every VAT-responsible taxpayer must issue the Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV). Once habilitated, the S.A.S. transmits FEV XML (Schema 1.0 and subsequent DIAN versions) to DIAN in real/near-real time through SOAP/API web services or the DIAN e-invoicing portal; each invoice must contain a unique CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) generated from a DIAN-assigned seed and be signed with the taxpayer's digital certificate. DIAN returns an acceptance receipt (acuse de recibo) that constitutes the digital stamp and confers fiscal validity. Export sales are issued as FEV 'Exportación 0%' and must be reconciled with the customs export declaration (DEX) and transport manifest prior to physical dispatch.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 481 of the Tax Statute, exports of tangible goods from Colombian customs territory qualify for 0% VAT when the S.A.S. owns the goods at shipment, title passes to a non-resident purchaser, physical exit is proved through official customs procedures, and the export proceeds are collected in accordance with the foreign-exchange regime. Sales to local Colombian intermediaries that will themselves export later are domestic sales taxed at 19% IVA. Offshore services rendered from Colombia to non-residents are also zero-rated when not economically connected to Colombian territory. For dried goji berries and herbal botanicals, INVIMA/ICA sanitary and phytosanitary documentation is required, as the VAT benefit presumes lawful and regular export operations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX – Declaración de Exportación), filed with DIAN's SIGLO XXI/VUCE customs system, validated by customs authorities, and stamped as the shipment physically leaves Colombian customs territory
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill) issued by the carrier evidencing dispatch abroad from a Colombian authorised port/airport and transfer of possession to the non-resident buyer

Inward Remittance Certificate (Declaración de Cambio submitted through an authorised foreign-exchange intermediary) evidencing collection/repatriation of the export proceeds in conformity with Banco de la República regulations
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-verifies the DEX, the FEV 0% export invoice, the cargo manifest, customs exit markings, and Banco de la República exchange declarations to prove actual shipment, title shift, and remittance timing. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day statutory deadline may render the zero-rated refund inadmissible and trigger foreign-exchange penalties. If the export is simulated, unsuccessful, or supported by false documentation, the exporter's claimed VAT refund is retrospectively clawed back with moratory interest and the taxpayer may be assessed the Article 648 inaccuracy penalty of 100% (up to 200%) of the tax understated or refund obtained, in addition to Article 660/661 late-filing penalties. Fraudulent export conduct also exposes the entity and its legal representatives to criminal liability for contrabando under Law 1762/2015, with imprisonment of 3 to 10 years, asset seizure, and an extended 10-year statute of limitations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting through its Junta Directiva as the Comisión de Cambios, which issues the foreign exchange regime, principally Resolución 8 de 2000 (as amended), and supervises the Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMC) for all mandatory channeling, exchange declarations, and international investment registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia applies a free-floating exchange rate regime. Current account operations (export/import of goods and services) are freely convertible but must be channeled exclusively through an IMC or a registered foreign-currency/compensation account. Capital account inflows (foreign direct investment) are also freely permitted without prior authorization, but must be registered with Banco de la República through the direttive investment registration mechanism to guarantee profit and capital repatriation rights; undistributed earnings, royalties, and dividends may be remitted abroad after compliance with Colombian corporate/tax formalities and registration updates, subject to presentation of the corresponding exchange declaration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be surrendered to the Colombian foreign exchange market (canalización obligatoria) by the SAS within six (6) months following the date of shipment (fecha de embarque) per Resolución 8 de 2000 as amended by Decreto 810 de 2021. No compulsory conversion ratio into COP applies; 100% of the export invoice proceeds may be held in USD/EUR or another freely convertible currency in a Colombian foreign-currency account or in a compensation account (cuenta de compensación) abroad registered with Banco de la República, but the funds must be formally channeled through an IMC, reconciled with the export customs declaration, and evidenced by the related Declaración de Cambio form filed with the intermediary bank. Non-channeled or late-channeled proceeds trigger fines, disallowance of tax benefits, and potential FX violation sanctions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) plus dedicated Foreign-Currency Deposit Account and capital-registration support for FDI channeling (Capital Escrow Account)
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with integrated trade finance desk and foreign-currency settlement account (Capital Escrow Account)
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) and USD clearing account with export proceed channeling capabilities (Capital Escrow Account)
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with global FX hedging access and foreign-currency account for cross-border settlements (Capital Escrow Account)
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with foreign trade financing and export collection services (Capital Escrow Account)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary clearing of Colombian export revenue; MEDIUM only as an ancillary treasury interface. Offshore fintech EMIs and electronic money institutions are not eligible Colombian IMCs and therefore cannot legally receive or pay COP through the local ACH/CUD clearing system, cannot register exchange declarations, and cannot hold the SAS's mandatory Export Proceeds channeling representation. Foreign e-wallet providers may be used for invoice reconciliation, client payment initiation, and settlement convenience for non-resident buyers, but every movement touching the Colombian SAS must ultimately flow into or out of a Colombian licensed IMC bank account; funds cannot be deemed channeled merely by passing through an offshore EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the default mandatory requirement in Colombian Tier-1 banks: at minimum the S.A.S. legal representative must attend an in-person KYC/onboarding interview (entrevista presencial) at a local branch, and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) must be personally identified where the UBO is a foreign resident. Some Tier-1 institutions accept a video-remote KYC interview complemented by OCR/liveness verification and digital acceptance of mandates, as allowed under Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia guidance, but remote-only onboarding is rarely granted to entities with foreign shareholders and non-registered foreign directors unless a Colombian notary or consular apostille chain is provided; the practical mandate is one physical appearance for the signing officer and documentary apostillization of all corporate resolutions for the finance and trade desks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex or undisclosed beneficial ownership chain, nominees, or holding-company structures above the legal-reporting threshold (Colombia applies a 5% beneficial ownership control threshold).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled corporate charters and powers of attorney; complete register of beneficial owners on the UBO statutory declaration; group organizational chart; nominee disclaimers and declaration of actual control; audited financial statements of the shareholder(s), certified by a recognized auditor; Colombian NIT/RUT registration; signed source of funds for the capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Name match against OFAC SDN, EU/UN sanctions, Colombian Fiscal Office lists, UIAF Lista Colombia, or negative-press hits in the herbal/botanical sector.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-screening resolution report generated by a licensed compliance provider; official list-matching evidence identifying false positives; biographical and corporate identity documentation demonstrating clear distinction from listed names; audited foreign partner contracts; export invoices and ICA phytosanitary registration showing licit commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Heightened scrutiny on the herbal/botanical trade requiring statutory license and export phytosanitary proof, especially if 'organic' claims are made and cross-border valuation appears unusual.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ICA export registration and current phytosanitary certification; organic certification from the Colombian Ministry of Agriculture or internationally accepted equivalency; laboratory certificate of active constituents; fair-market value study for the goji berry batches; USD invoice with Incoterm 2020 specification; buyer's bank reference and previous trade history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Relatively high volume of expected SWIFT wire legalization as compared to a standard Low_Risk_Standard wholesale category, combined with possibly east-coast counterparties in jurisdictions perceived as funds-flow risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Letter of legalization of the transaction chain; signed declarations of origin and legality of the proceeds; advance export shipment notifications; bank statements of the foreign buyer proving the origin country/funds upstream; UIAF-required format for source of funds/wealth and purpose of operations; confirmation that the entity's volume is commensurate with shipping manifests and phytosanitary certificates.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound foreign direct investment must be credited exclusively through a Colombian IMC bank account. The incoming SWIFT MT103/MT202 should be denominated 'REGISTRO INVERSION INTERNACIONAL – CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' and include the S.A.S. NIT, stated purpose code corresponding to direct investment under Resolución 8/2000, as well as the foreign investor's name. The receiving bank files the electronic Declaración de Cambio for capital inflows, completes the Registro de Inversión Internacional for the Colombian subsidiary, and endorses the foreign-currency deposit or COMES account entry; the SAS must remit the corporate shareholders' resolution, the notarized/apostilled subscription agreement, and proof of remittance source to allow the clearing of the inflow.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement for exported goji berries and herbal materials is executed through SWIFT MT103 for open-account and prepayment transactions, and through Commercial Documentary Letters of Credit (MT700 issued per UCP 600) or documentary collections (MT400/MT410) where the buyer requires formal banking security. The SAS must instruct the bank to tag outgoing trade payments (freight, brokerage, commissions, packaging, and incidental botanical services) with the corresponding exchange concept code, and to maintain export invoice, phytosanitary health, and transport documents in the bank's trade system so that foreign-currency segregation and matching are exact. Payment caused in COP may be converted at the market exchange rate or anchored via a hedged forward, and export proceeds must be channeled back within the statutory 6-month holidays; for re-export or cancellation of advanced collections, the appropriate expedited Aviso/Declaración must be filed.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/COP FX Forwards (compraventa de divisas a término) for commercial hedging of export proceeds
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) on USD/COP with cash settlement in COP, executed only through an IMC with documentary proof of underlying export exposure
USD/COP Cross-Currency Swaps (swap de tasa de cambio) for structured balance-sheet and receivables hedging through an authorized IMC

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual commercial registration renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (local Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 31 March; registration effective from 1 January to 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts a 25% surcharge on the registration fee plus default interest; failure to renew for two consecutive years triggers cancellation of the commercial registration and possible administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Asamblea de Accionistas – mandatory annual shareholders meeting to approve financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate minute book; copy filed with Superintendencia de Sociedades only if the entity is under formal supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the fiscal year-end, by 31 March each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene and hold the meeting exposes directors to civil liability for unaudited accounts and constitutes a compliance defect in chamber renewal and third-party legal audit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito y publicación de Estados Financieros certificados
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At the same time as the annual renewal filing, by 31 March, unless a later approval date is recorded in the corporate books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit of financial statements with the Chamber of Commerce prevents renewal verification and may lead to registration cancellation or weighted penalties in administrative enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración anual de Beneficiario Final (UBO update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in accordance with DIAN exógena reporting schedule; material UBO changes must be reported through RUT within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or late UBO information is subject to DIAN monetary fines under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Statute and may trigger heightened anti-money-laundering scrutiny.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory revisor fiscal (statutory audit) for SAS entities when gross assets at year-end exceed 5,000 monthly minimum legal wages (SMLMV) or gross income exceeds 3,000 SMLMV; also required if the entity is under public interest supervision or considered a financial group.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (Grupo 2 / IFRS for SMEs) under Law 1314 of 2009; fully converged IFRS (Grupo 1) only for entities with public interest or high-volume thresholds.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The statutory representative must confirm and file the complete list of ultimate beneficial owners, directly or indirectly controlling 5% or more of the shareholding, in the annual DIAN UBO report. Any transfer of shares that changes UBO must be reflected in the shareholder register and uploaded to RUT within 30 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory CIT holiday is available for dried goji berry/herbal botanical exporters under ISIC 4631. The general effective rate remains 35% unless the SAS qualifies as a Zona Franca permanent user (20% rate) or applies specific deductions for productive fixed-asset investment, environmental projects, or export-enabling investments. VAT on exportation is 0% for cross-border bulk sales, and foreign-source dividends received from abroad may be exempt or reduced under Colombian domestic rules.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios; filed electronically through DIAN MUISCA portal (www.muisca.gov.co or DIAN authorized tax software)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due in the calendar year following the fiscal year-end according to DIAN Resolution schedule, generally between 11 March and 15 April for calendar-year taxpayers; exact date is determined by the last two digits of the NIT (tax ID). For non-calendar fiscal years, one year from the closing date of the taxable period, aligned with DIAN calendar rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT, razón social, domicilio fiscal, primary economic activity code (ISIC 4631 / CIIU 4631), and fiscal period identification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Colombian SAS files under its NIT only. Non-resident beneficial owners are not separately entered in this box; their tax residence and ownership percentage are disclosed in the annual tax information questionnaire.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Ingresos Brutos por Ventas y Servicios
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income from international bulk export sales of organic dried lycium (goji) and herbal botanicals, including FOB invoice value, freight charges if part of invoiced sale, exchange-rate gains, and any ancillary logistic or processing revenues.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all export proceeds in Colombian pesos (COP) at the official dip (TRM) on each deposit date. Third-party wire transfers (Swift/TT) to the Colombian bank account must be traceable to the export invoices and customs declarations (DEX).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Returns, rebates, discounts, and credits granted to foreign buyers of goji berries or herbal goods.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident buyer's name and NIT (or passport/tax ID) must appear in the corresponding debit/credit notes; returns must be supported by customs re-import documentation where applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 – Costos de Venta y Adquisición de Mercancías
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Purchasing costs of organic dried goji berries, botanical raw materials, packaging, farming-supply costs, direct labor, and import duties if any, meeting statutory deductibility requirements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs from foreign suppliers must be evidenced by invoices, bills of lading, customs declarations, and proof of payment through authorized financial channels (FX wire or Swift).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 – Deducciones Generales y Gastos Administrativos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses, logistics, customs brokerage, compliance certificates, lab testing, freight insurance, legal fees, and treasury/funding costs directly related to the taxable generation of export income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign management fees, royalties, and technical services paid to non-resident shareholders or affiliates must be separately identified for withholding-tax and transfer-pricing treatment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income classified as statutorily exempt, such as certain biometric or rural-economy exemptions if applicable. Exportation per se is not an income-tax exemption; VAT zero-rating does not reduce CIT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not claim export VAT exemptions as CIT exemptions. Non-resident shareholders cannot acquire exempt status through the Colombian entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of prior-year tax losses against current-year net liquid income, subject to the 12-year carryforward period and the 25% annual limitation on taxable income offset.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward belongs to the Colombian SAS; it is not available to foreign shareholders and cannot be triggered by a change in beneficial ownership without observing anti-abuse rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 – Impuesto Generado, Descuentos, Anticipos, Retenciones y Saldo a Pagar/FAavor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 35% CIT rate to the liquid taxable rent, subtract applicable tax credits, withholdings, advance payments (anticipos), and determine the final balance payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source withholding taxes paid on export-related services can be credited under DTA or Colombian unilateral relief rules; the SAS must keep TRCs and certificates for at least 5 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission of Form 110 triggers a 5% monthly surcharge on the tax payable, capped at 100% of the tax (Art. 641 E.T.); if no tax is payable, a minimum fine of 10 UVT (approx. COP 470,000 for 2024) applies. Late payment of assessed tax accrues moratory interest at 1.5 times the benchmark bank rate. Omission or false statements may add a penalty of 20%–200% of the omitted tax and may constitute criminal tax evasion.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 120 – Declaración Informativa de Operaciones con Vinculados; filed via DIAN MUISCA (Form 120) as supplementary annual transfer-pricing return
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Form 120 must be filed no later than the final date for submitting Form 110, generally in April following the fiscal year-end to which the transactions refer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of related parties, including non-resident shareholders, beneficial owners, sister companies, and agents who purchase dried goji/herbal botanical products.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List the foreign related buyer with its full tax ID, country of residence, director names, and control relationship; an official TRC should be retained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate values per category: export sale of goods, purchases, services, interest, royalties, and management fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Colombian SAS must report all cross-border volumes regardless of whether they appear in the foreign counterparty's records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Métodos de Precios de Transferencia Aplicados
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the arm's-length method selected for each material intercompany transaction, including CUP, resale price, cost-plus, TNMM, or profit split.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident counterparty should cooperate to support the comparability analysis and provide the required local-country comparables.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cálculo del Ajuste y de la Renta Gravable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report resulting arm's-length price or margin, potential positive or negative adjustment, and any impact on taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a transfer-pricing adjustment increases Colombian taxable income, the additional 35% tax, default interest, and penalties may be assessed against the Colombian SAS.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file Form 120 or filing with omissions carries a penalty of up to 10% of the aggregate transaction value, limited to 15,000 UVT (approx. COP 706 million for 2024). Inadequate or not prepared transfer-pricing documentation can trigger the same penalty plus a secondary adjustment to taxable base; the DIAN may also impose 100% recharacterization of transactions when economic substance is absent.
